systems.name: Sol System
systems.description: Home system of the colony. The inner system is patrolled and safe; the middle belts are contested; the Reaches at the rim are lawless.

planets.name: Vesta
planets.description: A small cratered rocky planet close to the sun.

planets.name: Terra Nova
planets.description: An ocean world with a breathable atmosphere. Descend with X in orbit.

planets.name: Jovan
planets.description: A banded gas giant with a wide ring system.

planets.name: Ares
planets.description: A red desert planet with two moons and long-lasting dust storms.

planets.name: Nereid
planets.description: A blue ice giant with a thin ring, on the outer edge of Sol.

planets.name: Thule
planets.description: A frozen dwarf planet at the outer edge of Sol.

planets.name: Greyback
planets.description: A dark planetoid with a long greyseam vein. The Miners' Guild works the seam.

comets.name: Comet Halvorsen
comets.description: A comet on a long elliptical orbit, passing the sun every 45 minutes.

structures.name: Helios Array
structures.description: A ring of solar collectors around the sun, serviced by automated drones. The seat of the Helios Directorate.

nests.name: Nereid Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest built around a greyseam deposit in Nereid's orbit. Mites, and occasionally hulks.

nests.name: Helios Service Dock
nests.description: A maintenance cradle on the Helios Array's outer rail. Its drones are non-hostile.

nests.name: Helios Spares Dock
nests.description: A second maintenance cradle on the Helios Array, stocked with spare collector blades. Its drones are non-hostile.

nests.name: Helios Survey Dock
nests.description: The Helios Array's survey cradle, where the service docks file their performance logs. Its drones are non-hostile.

nests.name: Greyback Den
nests.description: A smugglers' den skimming greyseam from the Greyback seam. They won't attack unless provoked.

nests.name: Drift Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest built around a greyseam deposit in the Drift. Mites and crawlers.

nests.name: Grey Hour Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest built around the wreck of the Ark tender Grey Hour. Mites and crawlers.

nests.name: Far Drift Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest on the far side of the Drift. Mites and crawlers.

nests.name: Smugglers' Den
nests.description: A pirate base in a hollowed asteroid on the lanes beyond Jovan. Skiffs.

nests.name: Redtooth Camp
nests.description: A Redtooth camp on the lanes. Cutters, led by a brawler.

nests.name: Graveyard Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest among the Tenth Fleet's wrecks. Hulks.

nests.name: Reaches Den
nests.description: A pirate fortress asteroid in the outer belt. Veteran raiders and gunships.

nests.name: Thule Warcamp
nests.description: A Redtooth warband camp in Thule's orbit. Heavily plated.

nests.name: Shoal Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest in the outer shoal. Hulks.

nests.name: Wardens' Camp
nests.description: A Redtooth camp on the Wardens' Stillstone.

nests.name: Wardens' Den
nests.description: A pirate camp on the Wardens' Stillstone.

lodestones.description: The largest stillstone in Sol, beside the inner lanes. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
A stillstone sunward of the shipping lanes, used as a charging stop by haulers. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
A scarred stillstone in the Drift. About a third of it is inactive, and its field is weaker than normal. A salvage yard operates on the active side.
A stillstone on a slow orbit along the route to the Reaches. Jump drives charge faster within its field.

lodestones.name: Wardens' Stillstone
lodestones.description: A stillstone in the Reaches. Jump drives charge faster within its field. Redtooth and pirate camps are based on it.

zones.name: The Drift
zones.description: A band of junk and wreckage beyond Nereid, with Scrapborn nests throughout. Low threat.

zones.name: Helios Swarm
zones.description: Stray maintenance drones from the Helios Array. Non-hostile.

zones.name: Smugglers' Lanes
zones.description: The shipping lanes beyond Jovan, raided by pirates and Redtooth cutters.

zones.name: Graveyard of the Tenth
zones.description: The wrecks of the Tenth Fleet, now occupied by Scrapborn hulks.

zones.name: The Reaches
zones.description: The outer rim of Sol. Veteran pirates and Redtooth warbands. High threat.

zones.name: Wardens' Stillstone
zones.description: The Wardens' Stillstone and the raider camps on it.

zones.name: The Quiet Seam
zones.description: A large greyseam field on the outer edge of the shoal, short of Thule. No hostile nests.

regions.name: Inner Sol
regions.description: Patrolled space. Hostiles keep out, and ships lost here are rebuilt whole.

regions.name: Middle Sol
regions.description: Contested space: smugglers, the Drift and the Redtooth Picket.

regions.name: The Reaches
regions.description: Lawless space at the rim: pirate fortresses and warbands. Ships lost here lose their cargo.

systems.name: Ashfall Drift
systems.description: A brown dwarf with a dense, dusty asteroid belt and Halden ruins. Prospectors work the belt; Redtooth raiders hold an outpost in the outer system.

planets.name: Kindle
planets.description: A molten planet close to the brown dwarf.

planets.name: Cinderjack
planets.description: A banded gas giant nearly as large as its star. The Redtooth dig on its moon Halden.

structures.name: Halden Ring
structures.description: A ruined Halden ring around the brown dwarf, broken into arcs.

nests.name: Cinderjack Dig
nests.description: A Redtooth mining rig over a Halden cache on Cinderjack's outer moon. Cutters, and a Sledge hauler.

nests.name: Ashback Dig
nests.description: A Redtooth dig into a sealed Halden cache inside a belt asteroid.

nests.name: Scrapborn Nest
nests.description: A Scrapborn nest built around a greyseam vein. Non-hostile unless attacked.

lodestones.description: A stillstone just outside the Halden Ring. Jump drives charge faster within its field. A small settler camp is based on it.
A stillstone between the belt and Cinderjack. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
An uninhabited stillstone on a long orbit beyond Cinderjack. Jump drives charge faster within its field.

systems.name: Borealis System
systems.description: A cold blue-white star with a permanent aurora. Home of the ice sprites and the Frost Brood.

planets.name: Glacia
planets.description: An ice world with a Halden site beneath its glaciers. Descend with X in orbit.

planets.name: Pelagia
planets.description: A water world: open sea almost to the poles, a few island chains and small polar ice caps. One moon. Between Glacia and Boreas Major. No landing.

planets.name: Boreas Major
planets.description: A pale gas giant inside the aurora. Signal reception near it is poor.

zones.name: The Curtain
zones.description: The densest part of the aurora, where receivers pick up only static. Frost Brood nesting ground.

zones.name: The Rime Shoal
zones.description: An outer belt of aurora floes, ice veined with greyseam. The only source of aurora rime.

nests.name: Glacia Roost
nests.description: A Frost Brood roost in the ice over Glacia. Shards and Elders.

nests.name: Boreas Roost
nests.description: An old Frost Brood roost near Boreas Major. Fewer, larger Brood.

nests.name: Borealis Sift
nests.description: Scavenger drones stripping the inner belt, stacking their haul on a drifting frame.

nests.name: Shoal Roost
nests.description: A young Frost Brood roost among the aurora floes.

lodestones.description: A stillstone orbiting through the inner belt. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
A stillstone beyond the Rime Shoal. Jump drives charge faster within its field.

lodestones.name: Aurora Knot
lodestones.description: A small stillstone in the Curtain. Jump drives charge faster within its field. A Frost Brood roost surrounds it.

systems.name: Nebula Prime
systems.description: A young star inside its birth cloud. Rich asteroids and poor visibility. Nebula Prime Observatory is here.

planets.name: Verdance
planets.description: A planet under thick green cloud, with a hot surface.

nests.name: Opaline Den
nests.description: Rustjaw's raiding base, in a hollowed asteroid in Opaline's orbit. Gunships.

nests.name: Cloud Den
nests.description: A pirate hideout inside the birth cloud.

lodestones.description: A stillstone at the edge of the birth cloud. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
A stillstone in the haze beyond Opaline. Jump drives charge faster within its field.

systems.name: Void Sector
systems.description: A smaller black hole surrounded by debris fields. Void Wraiths are found here. Extreme threat.

planets.name: Umbra
planets.description: A dead rocky world, lit only by the accretion disk.

planets.name: Nyx
planets.description: An ice world heavily cratered by debris.

nests.name: Nyx Knot
nests.description: A dense debris cloud around Nyx. Wraiths emerge from it.

nests.name: Outer Knot
nests.description: A debris cloud near the scarred stillstone. Reavers emerge from it.

lodestones.description: A scarred stillstone orbiting the black hole. Part of it is inactive, and its field is weaker than normal.
The fragments of a shattered stillstone. It has no field.

systems.name: Cinder Reach
systems.description: A red giant. Ember dust fills the inner system; the belt is slag and iron.

planets.name: Ashfall
planets.description: A molten planet, its crust cracking under the red giant's heat.

planets.name: Kiln
planets.description: A scorched desert world with rich greyseam deposits. The Cinder Cult prevents mining.

nests.name: Ember Shrine
nests.description: A Cinder Cult shrine: an old hull converted into a furnace.

nests.name: Furnace Shrine
nests.description: The Cinder Cult's furnace in the outer belt, where Brands are fitted out.

nests.name: Reach Den
nests.description: A pirate base near the scarred stillstone. They trade with the Cult.

lodestones.description: A stillstone orbiting through the belt. Jump drives charge faster within its field. Cinder Cult shrines are nearby.
A scarred stillstone beyond the Ember Giant. Part of it is inactive, and its field is weaker than normal. Its ore-cutting camp is abandoned.
A dead stillstone with an abandoned refuelling camp. It has no field.

systems.name: The Maw
systems.description: A supermassive black hole with a bright accretion disk, circled by a ring of shards. Horizon Watch recovers inscribed fragments from the debris.

planets.name: Shard
planets.description: Half a planet, beside the shard ring.

planets.name: Pyre
planets.description: A burning planet near the disk. Its moon, Last Light, has a bastion.

nests.name: Pyre Knot
nests.description: A dense debris cloud around Pyre. Maw spawn emerge from it.

nests.name: Shard Knot
nests.description: Debris trailing Shard, where wraiths gather.

lodestones.description: The fragments of a shattered stillstone. It has no field.
A dead stillstone with an abandoned mining camp. It has no field.

zones.name: The Leestone Camp
zones.description: The Ark's leestone mining camp at the edge of the shard ring. Frequently attacked by the Cinder Cult.

systems.name: Glasswater Expanse
systems.description: A pulsar system with a frozen field of crystal and ice.

planets.name: Prism
planets.description: A ringed ice world with crystal plains.

planets.name: Halcyon
planets.description: A grey-green ocean world at the edge of the field, with the sealed Halcyon foundry in its crust.

nests.name: Halcyon Sift
nests.description: Scavenger drones stripping crystal in Halcyon's orbit. A Dredge collects their haul.

nests.name: Glasswater Den
nests.description: A pirate base in a hollowed asteroid beyond the crystal fields. Skiffs, raiders and occasional gunships.

lodestones.description: A stillstone close to the pulsar. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
A stillstone on a long orbit around the pulsar, used by Shardfall Depot's supply runs. Jump drives charge faster within its field.
The largest stillstone in the Expanse, in the outer field. Jump drives charge faster within its field.

systems.name: Terra Nova
systems.description: The surface of Terra Nova: temperate coasts and the city of New Meridian.

systems.name: Selene
systems.description: Terra Nova's moon. A bastion stands in its central crater and is attacked every night.

systems.name: Glacia
systems.description: The surface of Glacia: glaciers under the aurora, a Halden site, and New Halden pilgrims.

systems.name: Rimeholt
systems.description: Glacia's moon. A bastion stands on it and is attacked every night, harder than at Selene.

systems.name: Cinderhold
systems.description: A moon of cooling lava orbiting the Ember Giant. Its bastion is attacked every night by the Cinder Cult and pirates in Mk III hulls.

systems.name: Ashfall
systems.description: The surface of Ashfall: cracked crust over molten rock. A cave opens in the rock to the north.

systems.name: The Pyreclast's Cavern
systems.description: A cavern under Ashfall's crust: a long canyon running to the vault where the Pyreclast waits.

systems.name: Gloam
systems.description: Umbra's moon, at the edge of the disk. Its bastion is attacked every night by neutronium-built hostiles: the hardest siege.

systems.name: Last Light
systems.description: Pyre's moon, the last before the disk. Its bastion is attacked every night by cobalt-built hostiles from the Maw.

systems.name: The Deep Foundry
systems.description: The sealed Halcyon foundry beneath Halcyon's crust.

systems.name: Your Station
systems.description: Your private station, reached through the jump point at the site you chartered.

systems.name: The Scrap Mother's Nest
systems.description: The Scrap Mother's nest in the Drift: a hollowed asteroid, its chambers worked by scrapborn, her own at its heart behind a barrier. Junk drifts round it, and scrapborn patrol its face.

nests.name: Gullet Heap
nests.description: A heap of scrap in the Gullet's east alcove. Crawlers sit in it.

nests.name: Sorting Heap
nests.description: Scrap piled against the Sorting Floor's west wall, where the belts end. Sowers and darters come out of it.

nests.name: Smelter Heap
nests.description: Scrap heaped by the Smelter's pool. Crawlers keep pilots off the lodes.

nests.name: Gallery Heap
nests.description: The heap the Wreck Gallery's hauler is guarded from.

nests.name: West Face Heap
nests.description: Junk welded to drifting rock off the Nest Rock's west face.

nests.name: North Face Heap
nests.description: Junk welded to drifting rock off the Nest Rock's north face.

nests.name: Seam Heap
nests.description: A heap by the lodes on the Nest Rock's east face. Sowers patrol it.

systems.name: Vesta Training Yard
systems.description: A great cratered Vesta and the training yard floating above it. Closed to everyone but pilots in training.

regions.name: Vesta Yard
regions.description: The training yard. Nothing here can hurt you.

planets.name: Vesta
planets.description: A small cratered rocky planet close to the sun, seen close.

systems.name: Gun Range
systems.description: The stations' shared gun range: an indoor chamber with one big unshielded target at the far end. Try any weapon you can fit, then fly to the door and press X to go back to your station.
